steps.text: Rip the pita bread into bite-size pieces.
In a frying pan, melt some butter, add the bread pieces and fry until golden brown and crisp.
To the same pan add a little more butter, salt, approximately 2 cloves of crushed garlic, and a teaspoon of cumin; stir until aromatic, then add the fried bread pieces and toss to coat.
Transfer the coated bread pieces into a square glass baking dish and set aside.
In a pot, melt some butter and stir-fry the beef until browned.
Add the quartered onion, salt, pepper, chicken stock cube and enough water to cover the meat. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer, cover and cook until tender, approximately 2 hours.
Once cooled, remove the meat chunks into a bowl and reserve the cooking broth separately.
In a pot, melt some butter and stir-fry the noodles until golden brown.
Add the rice to the pot and stir until some of the rice turns opaque white. Add 540 ml of water and salt, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for about 35 minutes until tender.
Ladle some of the reserved meat broth over the bread pieces in the baking dish to saturate them.
Spoon the cooked rice evenly on top of the bread layer, then slowly ladle the remaining broth over the rice until it just reaches the top of the rice.

In a pan, heat a little olive oil or butter, then add the crushed tomatoes, tomato puree, 2 cloves of crushed garlic, cumin, salt, pepper and white wine vinegar. Stir until aromatic and slightly thickened into a red sauce.
Spread the red sauce over the rice layer with a wooden spoon to cover evenly.
In a pan, heat a little butter or oil, add the reserved meat chunks, a touch of tomato puree, crushed garlic, salt, pepper and cumin. Cook until the meat is golden fried.
Spoon the fried meat on top of the red sauce layer and serve.
